What this case comes down to is that the company decided to tell them that their religious beliefs were not valid.

So in terms of getting them back on the job, the company can do the right thing now.
We want the company to make amends for this process that they put in place that stripped my clients of their rights under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act.
So what kind of track are you on to get this into court and get them back on the job?
Oh, we're trying to move as quick as possible.
There's always a few hurdles to jump through when you're trying to bring a lawsuit.
And so we're working through that.
But we have 200 clients right now and we're working through the logistics of making sure all of them are going to have a claim against the company.

As a private employer, we can put policies in place to protect the health and safety of our workforce.

A lie that it can't be real.
